w:r.w:t: AI-Powered Rural Crisis Reporting & Volunteer Coordination System
Google Solutions Challenge • Flutter Android + Web • Rural India
"Design for the person with the least privilege — every other user will benefit automatically."
VolunTree is built on four non-negotiable pillars:
Radical Simplicity: Maximum 3 taps to complete any critical action. No onboarding. No feature tours.
Trust-First UX: Every state change confirms the system received the report. Users in crisis need psychological safety.
Inclusive Accessibility: 48dp minimum touch targets, 4.5:1 contrast ratio, TalkBack support, 6 Indian languages.
Offline Resilience: The app works with zero internet. Sync is background, automatic, and invisible to users.
Low Literacy: Icon + single-word label for every action. No multi-step text instructions anywhere.
Low Connectivity: App assumes offline by default. All data captured locally first, synced opportunistically on 2G/3G.
Low-End Devices: Target Android 8.0+ with 1.5GB RAM. No Lottie, no heavy animations, lazy lists throughout.
One-Handed Use: All primary CTAs in bottom 40% of screen. The thumb zone is sacred.
Shared Devices: Quick PIN or biometric login, no typed passwords. Session preserved if backgrounded for 1 hour.
Sun Glare: High contrast on warm white (#F8F8F6) background. Minimum 16sp body text. Never color-only meaning.
Palette inspired by India's landscape: forest greens for hope, warm ambers for urgency, earthy neutrals for stability.

The Capture Screen is the most critical experience. A field worker must be able to report in under 90 seconds.
Role Selection: Full-width icon cards (Field Worker / Volunteer). Selected card has green border.
PIN Entry: Custom 4-digit dot-based PIN pad. 48dp minimum per key. Auto-submits on 4th digit.
Biometric: Automatic fingerprint prompt if enrolled. Fallback PIN button always visible.
Language: First-run only, persisted in SharedPreferences, displayed in native script.
Error States: Wrong PIN = screen shake + red dot flash (no text). 3 failures = 30-second lockout with countdown.
No Email/Password: Credentials pre-assigned by coordinator. Workers never type usernames.

"AI should feel like a thoughtful colleague who already did the reading — not a chatbot, not a magic oracle."
Prominently displayed in Case Detail Panel. Visual design:
Green card with gradient (green-50 to blue-100 tint).
'✦ AI Summary' label in small uppercase — always clearly labeled as AI-generated.
Bold key finding sentence + supporting detail paragraph.
Tag row: issue type, affected group, urgency score, vulnerability indicators.
Urgency displayed as number (1–10) with color + plain-language label.
Always labeled: Every AI element carries a '✦ AI' badge. Coordinators know what's auto-generated.
Always editable: AI summaries can be overridden. The field is never locked — humans stay in control.
Confidence disclosure: If AI confidence <70%, card shows '⚠ Low confidence — verify manually'.
No AI on mobile: Field workers and volunteers never see AI terminology. It's invisible enrichment.
Smart Suggestions: Coordinator sees 'Suggested Volunteers' as soft recommendation pills, not forced assignment.
Privacy: Voice transcriptions show '[processing]' until ready. No audio playback without explicit coordinator action.
Scores 9-10: RED card, 'CRITICAL' label, pulsing pin on map.
Scores 1-4: GREEN card, 'LOW' label, no pulse animation.
A visually compelling 6-step narrative for the Google Solutions Challenge presentation.
WOW Moment: No complicated login. Worker taps role icon, touches fingerprint, immediately in capture mode. 3 taps to be ready to report.
Step 2: Capture Flood Photo + Voice Note
Worker photographs flooded road, hits voice button. Speaks in Hindi. WOW: Voice waveform animates live. Hindi speech transcribed to text in real time below the waveform.
App is offline. Button becomes 'Saved for Later.' Green checkmark animates. Queue badge shows '1 pending.' WOW: Report is safe even without internet.
Worker moves to higher ground with 2G signal. Background sync triggers automatically. Queue card shows progress bar. 'Report Synced!' green toast appears. WOW: Zero user action needed.

On coordinator's screen: red pulsing pin appears on Maharashtra map. Coordinator clicks it. Panel opens with photo, transcription, and AI summary. WOW: AI generates: 'Flash flood, urgent — 40+ villagers affected. Urgency: 9/10.'
Coordinator selects volunteer (2.3km away). One click confirm. WOW: Within 2 seconds, a WhatsApp message arrives on the volunteer's phone with address, photo, and instructions — fully automated.
